name: Balanced Craftwars Overhaul
desc:
A content rich game all about crafting gear to become stronger and fighting powerful bosses! Over 1000+ different items and 100+ different types of Enemies and Bosses! 

Private Servers are free, use them to grind alone in peace if you need.

Controls:
X - Ability 1
Z - Ability 2
C - Ability 3
F - Shield Ability
Q - Dash Ability
(Mobile is NOT recommended as compatibility is limited)

You can find more information in our server down below!

Special thanks to all of our contributors!
